text: The initiative is unique in being NGO-led but co-designed with government and technical partners. It prioritizes the secondary (winter) cropping season for drought risk, filling a gap in traditional monitoring programs. The drought component is built in partnership with the University of Reading on the TAMSAT-ALERT platform, which predicts vegetation indices to anticipate agricultural stress. The system emphasizes locally led governance to accelerate decision-making and ensure alignment with national and provincial priorities.
